title: AccessControlCatalogEntry
description: Standardized schema for enterprise electronic access control hardware, readers, locks, and power enclosures in NetSelect Enterprise

vendor.description: Manufacturer (e.g. 'Mercury Security', 'HID Global', 'HES / ASSA ABLOY', 'Securitron', 'Altronix', 'LifeSafety Power')

doorCapacity.description: Number of door openings controlled by this unit (e.g. 1, 2, 4, 8, 16)

readerCapacity.description: Number of card reader ports available on the controller

readerProtocols.description: Supported reader protocols (e.g. ['OSDP v2 Secure Channel', 'Wiegand'])

securityLevel.description: Orion TOW & Life Safety Egress Security Level: 1 = Public / Free Egress; 2 = Restricted Entry / Free Egress (drops on FAI); 3 = High-Security Vault / SCIF / Evidence (stays locked on FAI & power outage; MAGLOCKS STRICTLY PROHIBITED)

lockType.description: Locking hardware mechanism (critical for DRC Rule 11 egress validation)

failSecure.description: True if lock remains securely locked during power loss and fire alarm activation (Mandatory for Level 3)

poeStandard.description: If poe_switch powered, required IEEE PoE class

holdingForceLbs.description: Magnetic lock holding force in pounds (e.g. 600, 1200)

fireAlarmRelay.description: Has dedicated FAI fire alarm drop relay connection

ul294StandbyHours.description: Required standby battery reserve hours per UL 294 / NFPA 731

supportedEngines.description: Compatible VMS/ACS host software (e.g. ['Lenel OnGuard', 'Genetec Synergis', 'Software House C•CURE 9000', 'Avigilon Unity'])

mounting.description: Mounting method (e.g. 'Trove Backplate', 'DIN-Rail', 'Door Frame Mortise', 'Single-Gang Box')
